original.statement: ApplicationSet controller now reconciles an ApplicationSet only once when it is refreshed (bug fix).

corrected.statement: An ApplicationSet that is refreshed is now reconciled only once (bug fix 21171); before the fix, a refresh could trigger repeated reconciliation.

decision.reason: [ev-bda8048cc6c3] is a bug fix: a refreshed ApplicationSet is now reconciled only once. The configuration is the same and only the runtime behaviour differs, so behavior-changed is correct, and protocol-behavior named from the evidence's own words is acceptable. The evidence never names an "applicationset-controller" component, though. It only has the conventional-commit scope "appset", so I removed the component field, which isn't supported.
